limitations.note: Replacing the falling-edge count comparison with a delayed copy of `clkp` fixed the duty cycle but shifted both divide-by-seven output edges half an input cycle later than the one-line threshold fix.
The test accepted transitions on either input edge and checked pulse widths, but never checked which edge the output should first rise on after reset, so it passed despite the phase mismatch.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected before it ran, forcing the agent to resubmit the test with a different temporary-directory setup.
